_doc: Tier-3 OOS: real venture (Bland AI) — AI voice/phone agents for businesses. Raised $40M Series B (Apr 2024) led by Y Combinator + Scale Venture Partners. Strict OOS — venture and case constructed from public press only. Tests an AI voice category we have not yet benchmarked.
_oos_provenance: Bland AI Series B announcement Apr 2024; Bland.ai blog public claims; PolyAI / Air.ai / Synthflow public funding for analog comps

venture_under_test.name: Bland AI
venture_under_test.description: Bland AI is a B2B SaaS platform providing AI voice agents that handle inbound and outbound phone calls autonomously for sales prospecting, customer support, appointment booking, and lead qualification. Target customers: high-volume call-center operations at companies with 50-2000 employees in real estate, insurance, healthcare scheduling, debt collection, and outbound sales. Pricing: $0.09 per minute of conversation + $99/month base subscription. Target buyer: VP of Sales, Director of Customer Experience, and Head of Call Center Operations. Competes with PolyAI, Air.ai, Synthflow, Vapi, and Retell AI. Differentiation: sub-400ms response latency (vs competitors' 1-2 second pauses that feel non-human), conversational AI fine-tuned per industry vertical (insurance vs retail vs healthcare), and direct telephony integration without requiring Twilio markup.
